rows.name: placement
rows.description: The placement of the arrow can be placed at the top, bottom, left or right of the tooltip

rows.name: alignment
rows.description: The placement of the arrow can be aligned on the left hand, right hand or centrally on the tooltip

rows.name: triggerEvent
rows.description: The event(s) that trigger tooltip to be shown

rows.name: defaultOpen
rows.description: The initial value for the open state.

rows.name: open
rows.description: Whether the tooltip is open or not. Use together with `onOpenChange

rows.name: onOpenChange
rows.description: Fires when the open state changes.

rows.name: offset
rows.description: Offset (in pixels) of tooltip from Trigger element

rows.description: Determines if tooltip should flip position when there is not enough space

rows.name: trigger
rows.description: Element that will be used as trigger for the tooltip to open *

rows.name: label
rows.description: Text to be displayed inside tooltip

rows.name: openDelay
rows.description: Delay for opening the tooltip (in milliseconds)

rows.description: Delay for closing the tooltip (in milliseconds)
